dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Hello! Are you interested in studying in Canada?
dialogue.reading: həˈloʊ! ər juː ˈɪntrəstɪd ɪn ˈstʌdiɪŋ ɪn ˈkænədə?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I'd like to go as an exchange student, but I'm worried about the cost.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈɡoʊ əz ən ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ˌstuːdənt, bʌt aɪm ˈwɜːrid əˈbaʊt ðə ˈkɔːst.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I understand. Although tuition is high, a lot of our students get scholarships.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd. ɔːlˈðoʊ tuˈɪʃən ɪz ˈhaɪ, ə ˈlɑːt əv aʊr ˈstuːdənts ˈɡɛt ˈskɑːlərʃɪps.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Can I apply for a scholarship as an exchange student?
dialogue.reading: kən aɪ ˈæpli fər ə ˈskɑːlərʃɪp əz ən ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ˌstuːdənt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes. Even though you're only staying for one semester, you can apply for one.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˌiːvən ˈðoʊ jʊr ˈoʊnli ˈsteɪɪŋ fər ˈwʌn səˈmɛstər, juː kən ˈæpli fər ˈwʌn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: How much does the scholarship pay?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈmʌtʃ dʌz ðə ˈskɑːlərʃɪp ˈpeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It pays half of your tuition.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈpeɪz ˈhæf əv jʊr tuˈɪʃən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's great. My parents are teachers. Although they want to help me, they can't pay for everything.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈɡreɪt. maɪ ˈpɛrənts ər ˈtiːtʃərz. ɔːlˈðoʊ ðeɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈhɛlp miː, ðeɪ ˈkænt ˈpeɪ fər ˈɛvriθɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Then you should apply. Even though the form is long, please don't give up!
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn juː ʃʊd ˈæpli. ˌiːvən ˈðoʊ ðə ˈfɔːrm ɪz ˈlɔːŋ, ˈpliːz ˈdoʊnt ˈɡɪv ˈʌp!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: March 31. You can find everything on our website.
dialogue.reading: ˈmɑːrtʃ ˈθɜːrti ˈfɜːrst. juː kən ˈfaɪnd ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɑːn aʊr ˈwɛbsaɪt.
